ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver.

rejected_claims.reason: Misapplies NS-3: NS-3 governs driver-initiated cancellations without a valid reason, but the record shows the rider cancelled [F2], so NS-0 directs the case to NS-4. No account action on the driver follows from this cancellation under NS-3.

The rider's no-show dispute history [F13] and the driver's trip volume/rating [F14] are profile facts, which under the procedural rules cannot decide the case; the outcome turns on the driver's GPS and button records [F1][F3][F4] under NS-1/NS-2/NS-4.

The driver's point that band 3 traffic [F10] is outside the severe range and that no incident was recorded [F11] is not adverse to the rider's outcome: it confirms no reasonable-cause excuse exists under NS-1, so the fee still fails [NS-1][NS-4].

NS-2's account-flag add-on requires a recorded "I'm Here" tap while GPS shows the driver outside the pickup radius; F4 shows no tap at all, so the flag trigger is unmet and no account action is warranted [NS-2]. Claim withdrawn by the rider advocate, confirmed here.
